covered.fragment: This paper proposes a two-stage stochastic framework for shared battery ESS siting, sizing and installation timing under investment-cost uncertainty.

A derivative-free search explores discrete investment plans, and an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM)-based coordination procedure evaluates their operation under load, renewable-generation and market-price uncertainty.
\item A stochastic framework plans shared storage at transmission--distribution interfaces

\item \textcolor{blue}{A two-stage stochastic planning framework for shared ESS deployment at TN--DN interface nodes that determines a multi-year investment plan and evaluates it against scenario-dependent coordinated TSO--DSO operation.}

\item \textcolor{blue}{A nested solution strategy combining a derivative-free investment search with ADMM-based decentralized operational evaluation, together with explicit numerical acceptance criteria for assessing the resolution of planning comparisons.}

\item \textcolor{blue}{A case study on an integrated 108-bus system that quantifies the value of coordination against static interface practice, the break-even conditions for shared storage in energy cost and flexibility price, and the role of degradation in the investment decision.}
The resulting shortfall of 81.3~k\euro{} exceeds the reported numerical resolution of 18.0~k\euro{}.
This range reflects estimated remaining movement in the no-storage evaluation and is not a certified interval.

The two-stage stochastic formulation links investment decisions with coordinated TSO--DSO operation under uncertainty, while battery degradation couples storage utilisation with available capacity over the planning horizon.

main_tex: A stochastic framework plans shared storage at transmission--distribution interfaces
Battery degradation links storage dispatch with long-term available capacity
No evaluated storage plan recovers its investment cost under baseline assumptions
Reference unit margins are positive at 1.75 and 2 times the base flexibility price
Coordination without storage cuts operating costs by 12.2\% versus price-taking

Every recourse evaluation is certified; every planning difference has a resolution
Without ageing the reference storage unit breaks even; with ageing it loses
Coordination is worth 13.9\,\% of operating cost against static interface practice
